fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Unique order identifier from the source system (prefixed with source name for deduplication)

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Customer identifier from the originating system

fields.name: customerEmail
fields.description: Customer email address for cross-system matching

fields.name: orderDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the order was placed (ISO 8601)

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Normalized order status: pending | confirmed | shipped | delivered | cancelled | refunded

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Full shipping address as a single line

fields.name: lineItemCount
fields.description: Number of distinct line items in the order

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last modification timestamp from the source system
